claims.statement: parse_salary_band parses Vietnamese free-text salary into (min, max) VND/month. Handles triệu/tr, nghin/k, plain 6+ digits. Single values return (value*0.8, value) for negotiation range.
is_salary_profile_statement detects first-person salary declarations via 8 Vietnamese markers (mong muon, ky vong, expected salary, etc.). Distinct from parse_salary_band: detects intent, not values.
RecommendationWeights: title=0.35, salary=0.25, location=0.20, support=0.10, experience=0.10. Tunable via Settings rec_weight_* fields. Formula: total = weighted sum of 5 scoring functions.
score_job applies the weighted formula and returns ScoredJob with composite score (3 decimals) + concatenated reasons. Falls back to 'việc làm đang tuyển' when no specific reasons generated.

select_matching_active_jobs filters by role (title), company (name/aliases/factory/project), location (province/district/address). Company/location support identity-typo matching via SequenceMatcher (threshold 0.86) and acronym detection. Sorting: salary_desc, salary_asc, created_at.

RecommendationQueryPort consumed by the bot brain: recommend_jobs_for_lead(chat_id, top_k=5) loads lead, scores all active jobs, returns top-K. list_active_jobs provides direct filtered lookup without scoring.

provider_from_conversation resolves canonical provider (zalo_bot, zalo_oa, facebook_messenger) from channel identity, falling back to legacy zalo_channel field. SUPPORTED_CONVERSATION_PROVIDERS = frozenset({zalo_bot, zalo_oa, facebook_messenger}).
